result.instructions: Tools for KashFlow, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which sales invoices are overdue, and how much is outstanding in total?"; "Show my profit and loss for the last tax year."; "What does Acme Ltd owe me, and which invoices are still unpaid?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes KashFlow data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kashflow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kashflow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kashflow_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. kashflow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kashflow_get_company_details
tools.title: Get company details
tools.description: The KashFlow company: name, address, contact, VAT registration, currency, payment terms and business type. SOAP GetCompanyDetails.

tools.name: kashflow_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: All customers (name, code, contact, email, phone, address, VAT number, payment terms, notes), paged here: the reply says total and next_offset. SOAP GetCustomers.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer by code
tools.description: One customer by its KashFlow customer code (the short code shown in the customer list, e.g. ACME01). SOAP GetCustomer.

tools.name: kashflow_get_customer_by_id
tools.title: Get customer by id
tools.description: One customer by its numeric CustomerID (as returned in other replies). SOAP GetCustomerByID.

tools.name: kashflow_find_customer_by_email
tools.title: Find customer by email
tools.description: The customer whose e-mail address matches. SOAP GetCustomerByEmail.

tools.name: kashflow_get_customer_balance
tools.title: Get customer balance
tools.description: What one customer owes: the total invoiced value and the outstanding balance. SOAP GetCustomerBalance.

tools.name: kashflow_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer. The code must be unique (KashFlow refuses a code that exists) and nothing existing is changed. Returns the new CustomerID. SOAP InsertCustomer.

code.description: A unique customer code, e.g. ACME01.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. GB.

tax_region.description: VAT classification of the customer: uk (default, domestic), eu (EC customer) or outside_eu. Set it for customers outside the UK.

tools.name: kashflow_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: All suppliers (name, code, contact, email, phone, address, VAT number, payment terms), paged here: the reply says total and next_offset. SOAP GetSuppliers.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_get_supplier
tools.title: Get supplier by code
tools.description: One supplier by its KashFlow supplier code. SOAP GetSupplier.

tools.name: kashflow_create_supplier
tools.title: Create supplier
tools.description: WRITE: create a new supplier. The code must be unique (KashFlow refuses a code that exists) and nothing existing is changed. Returns the new SupplierID. SOAP InsertSupplier.

code.description: A unique supplier code, e.g. OFFICE01.

eu_supplier.description: True for a supplier in another EU country (EC supplier). Default false (UK).

tools.name: kashflow_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice by number
tools.description: One sales invoice by its invoice number: customer, dates, lines (description, quantity, rate, VAT), net, VAT, amount paid and a link. SOAP GetInvoice.

tools.name: kashflow_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices by date range
tools.description: Sales invoices dated within a range (inclusive; a bare end date means the end of that day), paged here. Dates are yyyy-mm-dd. SOAP GetInvoicesByDateRange.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_list_customer_invoices
tools.title: List a customer's invoices
tools.description: All sales invoices of one customer, by numeric CustomerID (see kashflow_get_customer for the id), paged here. SOAP GetInvoicesForCustomer.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_list_unpaid_invoices
tools.title: List unpaid invoices
tools.description: All sales invoices not yet paid in full, paged here. SOAP GetInvoices_Unpaid.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_list_overdue_invoices
tools.title: List overdue invoices
tools.description: All sales invoices past their due date and not paid in full, paged here. SOAP GetInvoices_Overdue.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_list_recent_invoices
tools.title: List recent invoices
tools.description: The most recently created sales invoices. SOAP GetInvoices_Recent.

tools.name: kashflow_list_invoice_payments
tools.title: List payments of an invoice
tools.description: The payments recorded against one sales invoice (date, amount, method, bank account, note), by invoice number. SOAP GetInvoicePayment.

tools.name: kashflow_list_payments_by_date
tools.title: List invoice payments by date range
tools.description: Customer payments received within a date range (date, amount, invoice, method, bank account). KashFlow returns them a page at a time: set page_number 1, 2, ... until a page comes back empty. Dates are yyyy-mm-dd. SOAP GetInvoicePaymentsByDateRange.

annotations.title: List invoice payments by date range

tools.name: kashflow_get_invoice_notes
tools.title: Get invoice notes
tools.description: The notes attached to one sales invoice, by its InvoiceDBID (the numeric id in invoice replies, not the invoice number). SOAP GetInvoiceNotes.

tools.name: kashflow_add_invoice_note
tools.title: Add invoice note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a sales invoice, by its InvoiceDBID (the numeric id in invoice replies). Existing notes and the invoice are not changed. SOAP InsertInvoiceNote.

note_date.description: Note date, yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss (default: now, UTC).

tools.name: kashflow_list_quotes
tools.title: List quotes
tools.description: All sales quotes (same shape as invoices), paged here. SOAP GetQuotes.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_get_receipt
tools.title: Get purchase by number
tools.description: One purchase (supplier invoice / receipt) by its receipt number: supplier, dates, lines, net, VAT, amount paid. SOAP GetReceipt.

tools.name: kashflow_list_recent_receipts
tools.title: List recent purchases
tools.description: The most recently created purchases (supplier invoices / receipts). SOAP GetReceipts_Recent.

tools.name: kashflow_list_supplier_receipts
tools.title: List a supplier's purchases
tools.description: All purchases (supplier invoices / receipts) of one supplier, by numeric SupplierID (see kashflow_get_supplier), paged here. SOAP GetReceiptsForSupplier.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: The product catalogue (name, code, description, price, stock level), paged here. SOAP GetProducts.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_list_bank_accounts
tools.title: List bank accounts
tools.description: The bank accounts (AccountID, name, nominal code). SOAP GetBankAccounts.

tools.name: kashflow_list_bank_transactions
tools.title: List bank transactions
tools.description: The transactions of one bank account (date, money in/out, VAT, type, comment, customer/supplier), by AccountID from kashflow_list_bank_accounts, paged here. SOAP GetBankTransactions.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_get_bank_balance
tools.title: Get bank balance
tools.description: The balance of one bank account on a date (default today). SOAP GetBankBalance.

tools.name: kashflow_list_nominal_codes
tools.title: List nominal codes
tools.description: The chart of accounts: nominal codes with their names. SOAP GetNominalCodes.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_list_vat_rates
tools.title: List VAT rates
tools.description: The VAT rates set up in the account. SOAP GetVATRates.

tools.name: kashflow_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: The projects defined in the account (id, name). SOAP GetProjects.

tools.name: kashflow_get_profit_and_loss
tools.title: Get profit and loss
tools.description: The profit and loss report for a date range: turnover, cost of sales, gross profit, expenses and net profit, with the lines of each section. SOAP GetProfitAndLoss.

tools.name: kashflow_get_balance_sheet
tools.title: Get balance sheet
tools.description: The balance sheet at a date (default today): fixed assets, current assets, current liabilities, capital and reserves with the lines of each. SOAP GetBalanceSheet.

date.description: Balance sheet date, yyyy-mm-dd (default today, UTC).

tools.name: kashflow_get_trial_balance
tools.title: Get trial balance
tools.description: The trial balance for a date range: every nominal code with debit, credit and balance. SOAP GetTrialBalance.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_get_aged_debtors
tools.title: Get aged debtors
tools.description: Who owes you money at a date (default today), aged into current, three periods and older, per customer. SOAP GetAgedDebtors.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_get_aged_creditors
tools.title: Get aged creditors
tools.description: Who you owe money to at a date (default today), aged into current, three periods and older, per supplier. SOAP GetAgedCreditors.

limit.description: How many records to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0), to get the next page.

tools.name: kashflow_get_vat_report
tools.title: Get VAT report
tools.description: The VAT return figures (boxes 1 to 9) for a period, and whether it was submitted to HMRC. SOAP GetVATReport.

start_date.description: Start of the VAT period, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: End of the VAT period, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: kashflow_get_kpis
tools.title: Get KPIs
tools.description: Key figures for a date range (income, expenses, profit and similar, as name/value pairs). SOAP GetKPIs.

exclude_vat.description: Leave VAT out of the figures (default false).

exclude_same_day_payments.description: Leave out invoices paid the day they were issued (default false).
